lead.headline: Abilene Christian scores 101 to win at South Dakota State
lead.deck: The Wildcats beat the Jackrabbits 101-95 as 7-point underdogs. UT Arlington took over the power rankings, and Central Arkansas covered twice.
body: Abilene Christian went to South Dakota State as a 7-point underdog and won 101-95. Isaac Dye led the Wildcats with 22 points, three days after scoring 21 in an 87-68 win over Southwestern Adventist. It was the best road result in the UAC this week, and the model, which has ACU 248th nationally, will have to catch up.

UT Arlington moved to first in the power rankings and has the league's best record at 6-2. The Mavericks won 69-62 at Northwestern State as 3.5-point favorites behind Tristan Hankins' 18 points and five assists. Then they were 5-point favorites at home against Oral Roberts and lost 84-80, with Noah Shelby scoring 23.

Central Arkansas slid from first to second in the power rankings and had a better week than that suggests. The Bears won 82-67 at Jacksonville as 3.5-point favorites and 80-66 at North Florida as 8.5-point favorites, covering both. Our model has them 116th nationally at plus-5.6 points per 100 possessions, the top rating in the league by almost six points.

Eastern Kentucky lost 79-76 at home to Bellarmine as an 8.5-point favorite, then lost 85-72 at Miami (OH) as a 14-point underdog. Austin Peay lost 79-73 at home to UTRGV as a 5.5-point favorite, despite 26 points from Zyree Collins.

The league went 9-7. North Alabama is 5-2 and second in the standings, but ninth in the power rankings and 328th in our model. The Lions beat Alabama A&M 77-74 as 3.5-point favorites and didn't cover.

column.label: Look Ahead
column.title: Three road games against bigger names
body: **UT Arlington at Colorado State, Tuesday, 9 p.m.** The new No. 1 in the power rankings on the road. No line posted yet.
**North Alabama at DePaul, Tuesday, 8 p.m.** The team whose record and rating disagree the most goes on the road. This one should settle the argument.
**Central Arkansas at Houston, Wednesday, 8 p.m.** The league's best team by our numbers, on the road after two straight covers. No line posted yet.

notes.headline: West Georgia gave up 124
notes.body: The Wolves lost 124-85 at Tennessee Tech as 14.5-point underdogs. Kenneth Chime had 18 points and 13 rebounds. They beat Paine 105-56 behind Marshal Destremau's 15 and 18.

notes.headline: Little Rock lost at North Florida
notes.body: The Trojans were 5-point favorites and lost 99-87. Jalen Lyn scored 20. They beat Arkansas Baptist 82-47 at home.
